focus.jnote: The tape is calming after a rough, chip-led week. U.S. stock futures climbed ahead of Friday's open as the technology selloff showed signs of easing and Treasury yields retreated from recent multi-year highs, with the 10-year near 5.09%. Thursday was a relief session — all three major U.S. indexes finished higher as investors shifted money out of major tech and into other sectors; the S&P 500 rose 0.33% and the Nasdaq Composite gained 0.08%, both ending a three-day losing streak. Asia stabilized overnight too: the Kospi closed 2.05% higher after falling 7.6% the prior session, while Japan's Nikkei gained 1.8%. Volatility eased — the VIX spot price was 16.01, down 2.73%. Still, Nasdaq futures only inched up after the index flipped sharp intraday losses Thursday, and AI stocks remained fragile with chip makers slipping in premarket. The scanner boarded one name into this — validate it hard at 9:35.
focus.notdown: No clean bullish Sniper boarded today. The Type C breakout scan ran (794 examined → 252 within the proximity band → 10 breakout-confirmed → 0 boarded) and nothing cleared validation into a tape where chips are still fragile. Rotation into non-tech/cyclicals is the week's theme — the Russell 2000 advanced 1.38% Thursday — but that is a drift, not a single named, boardable breakout. Watch-only: on a day where the only boarded name is a thin-volume bear, there is no bullish table-pounder.
focus.notup: One bearish Type A gap boarded — TRV — and it carries the same fatal flaw that has plagued this week's bears: near-zero confirming volume plus a catalyst that cuts the wrong way. Travelers actually posted a blowout: EPS of $9.18 came in 24.8% above expectations and revenue of $12.41B beat too, yet the stock slipped right after the filing. The drop is about what sits underneath — catastrophe losses climbed to $538 million (up from $402M a year earlier) and premiums stayed flat. Shorting a ~25% EPS beat on 0.04x relative volume into a calming tape is exactly the overshoot-snap-back risk 4-VAL exists to prevent. Minimum size, lean skip unless it validates down clean at 9:35.
focus.why: Why YELLOW (not GREEN)? The gap engine cooled — composite ~44 (MILD) and P(≥1% gap) ~33% sits just under the 35% trigger — but two things keep this from GREEN: (1) AI/chip fragility is not resolved — Nasdaq-100 futures were still ~3.09% lower over five days and chip makers slipped again premarket; and (2) the lone boarded name is a thin-volume bear off a huge double-beat, a textbook overshoot. The disciplined read is half size, A-grade only, hard-validate at 9:35. If TRV opens green, fades, or stays on 0.04x volume — stand aside. Cash is a position.

setups.read: Travelers (TRV) is a bearish Type A post-earnings gap boarded at Grade A — but read the caution, don't short it blind. This was a massive double-beat, not a miss: EPS of $9.18 came in 24.8% above expectations and revenue of $12.41B beat too, yet the stock slipped right after the filing. The gap-down is about the fine print — rising catastrophe losses of $538 million (vs $402M a year ago) and flat premiums. Shares fell 4.02% to ~$368.72 in Friday's premarket despite the strong quarter, after closing Thursday at $383.89. Four honest cautions: (1) scanner shows relative volume ~0.04x — far below the 1.3x confirmation bar, the single biggest red flag; (2) you're shorting a 25% EPS beat, so this bets the de-rate continues against strong fundamentals; (3) three S/R layers sit just ABOVE the gapped price (sma20 ~$366.31, swing ~$373.55, gap floor ~$383.89), so the cushion to a bear-call short strike is thin; (4) no OI data returned — verify manually. ATM spread $1.20 passes. Next earnings ~Jan 2027, outside DTE. On a MILD-but-fragile tape this is strictly 4-VAL-at-9:35, minimum size, lean skip.
setups.check_note: Bearish 4-VAL at 9:35: need price < $383.89 (gap holding down), < today's open, lower third of range. Volume ~0.04x is WAY below the 1.3x bar — the key disqualifier; and this was a ~25% EPS beat, so a snap-back is a real risk. Confirm OI manually (none returned). Short call well above price (above the ~$373.55 swing / ~$383.89 gap floor); minimum size, skip if it opens green, volume stays thin, or it reclaims $373+.
